title: appointment.created v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer. Emitted when a new appointment is scheduled. TWO real producer paths land on this exact stream/shape (both fire for the same creation, per appointments.ex:259-274's comment 'Best-effort immediate fan-out ... the durable delivery already happened'): (1) durable outbox — Appointments.insert_with_outbox/insert_or_rollback (appointments.ex:651-676) calls AlebrijeAgenda.Outbox.emit("appointment.created", appt), whose envelope_for/2 (outbox.ex:96-109) builds this exact flat shape (including the optional contact_id) inside the SAME transaction as the appointment insert, relayed at-least-once by OutboxRelayWorker to the literal stream "appointment.created" (outbox.ex:75, @stream_routes — payments-go's EVENTBUS_STREAM_APPOINTMENT_CREATED reads this bare stream); (2) best-effort direct XADD — EventPublisher.publish_appointment_created/1 (event_publisher.ex:38-41) -> publish/2 (event_publisher.ex:65-104), called right after the transaction commits (appointments.ex:266-268), which stamps event_type via Map.put(payload, "event_type", @created_stream) onto the SAME payload/1 shape (event_publisher.ex:65-73) but WITHOUT contact_id (that field only exists in outbox.ex's envelope_for/2). Both converge through the shared AlebrijeCommon.EventBus.Producer.publish/2 (producer.ex:25 — JSON-encodes the flat map directly, no second envelope layer). Registered here under the producer's real event_type ('appointment.created', 2-segment) — no schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema / {:error,{:no_schema,...}} fail-open at Producer.publish/2's validate/1, producer.ex:52-56). Precedent for the flat/optional-field pattern: appointment.noshow.v1.json (DEBT #177). DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

event_type.description: Canonical event_type EN-USO. Always present: outbox.ex's envelope_for/2 sets it directly (outbox.ex:97), and the direct path stamps it via Map.put (event_publisher.ex:97).

appointment_id.description: UUID of the created appointment. Stringified (to_string(id || "")) by both producers; empty string when absent.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the appointment (ADR-25). Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

calendar_id.description: Calendar the appointment belongs to. Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

contact_id.description: UUID of the CRM contact tied to the appointment. ONLY present via the outbox path (outbox.ex:96-105) — envelope_for/2 drops this key entirely when blank (drop_blank/2) rather than emitting an empty string, and the direct EventPublisher path (event_publisher.ex:65-73) never sets it at all. Consumers must treat it as optional.

contact_phone.description: E.164 contact phone on the appointment. Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

status.description: Appointment status at emit time; 'scheduled' for this event.

service_type.description: Appointment service_type (e.g. 'lab_standard', 'lab_domicile'). Aditivo, ADR-31 §5.1 (2026-07-10) — added to event_publisher.ex's payload/1 alongside context_id/start_time/end_time/domicile_address so field-ops-ex's AppointmentConsumer can materialize a pickup_sample field order for service_type=='lab_domicile' (DEBT-FO-BLOQUE-C-BRIDGE). Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent — existing consumers ignore unknown keys per §5.3 forward-compat.

context_id.description: Multi-context id (ADR-25) the appointment belongs to, if any. Added 2026-07-10, see service_type note above. Stringified; empty string when absent.

start_time.description: Appointment start_time. Added 2026-07-10, see service_type note above. Stringified via Elixir's to_string/1 (DateTime.to_string/1 format, e.g. '2026-07-15 14:00:00.000000Z' — space-separated, RFC3339-compatible for parsers that accept a space or 'T' date/time separator); empty string when absent.

end_time.description: Appointment end_time. Same format/notes as start_time. Added 2026-07-10.

domicile_address.description: Domicile address for lab_domicile appointments. Always a JSON-encoded string on the wire (the DB column is TEXT-as-JSON) even though agenda-ex's in-memory Appointment struct sometimes holds it as a decoded map post-Appointments.decode_domicile/1 — the publisher re-encodes it back to a string before emitting. Added 2026-07-10. Empty string when absent.
